column3: ## Test Article Landing Page Metadata and Affiliations Display
Ensure there is a publicly available article in DOAJ with multiple authors, where at least one author has multiple affiliations and an ORCID iD.
Navigate to the article landing page at /article/<article_id> or search for the article on /search/articles and click on its title

column4: The article title is displayed prominently at the top
The journal title is displayed and links to the journal Table of Contents page
The list of authors is displayed
Publication date, volume, issue, and page numbers are displayed if provided
DOI and Full-Text URL links are displayed and active
Abstract and Keywords are displayed if provided

column3: Click on the "Affiliations" button/accordion under the authors list

column4: Each author is listed with their respective affiliations
Authors with multiple affiliations display each affiliation on a separate line
Authors with ORCID iDs display a clickable ORCID icon/link to their ORCID profile
